relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a man with a LAMP2 variant: "Genetic analysis revealed a thymine deletion at position 121 (121 delT) in exon 2 of the LAMP2 gene".
method_note: Hand-extracted from a short case report (no tables); one in-scope person labelled 'patient' (rule 5). No relatives or previously published individuals are described. Age: the paper gives '19-year-old' at the August 2011 emergency evaluation and in the abstract ('a report of an asymptomatic 19-year-old man'); it is recorded as age at time of report, but follow-up continued about one year after diagnosis, so the age at last contact is not stated; age at diagnosis is not stated explicitly and is left 'not reported'. Variant printed only as '121 delT' (not HGVS c. notation), so cdna_hgvs_as_stated is null; no transcript, protein change, variant class, zygosity or parental testing stated. Skeletal muscle: biopsy 'showed myopathy' and CK/aldolase were elevated, while the text also states absence of 'clinically significant skeletal myopathy' and 'symptomatic peripheral myopathy'; both kinds of rows are emitted and the checklist item 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' is left 'not reported' (weakness itself is not mentioned). Atrioventricular block: the only AV block is a transient 3rd-degree heart block induced during cryoablation; recorded literally as observed (procedure-related). Cognition: 'absence of mental retardation' and 'neither of cognitive impairment' are used to exclude the composite checklist item; learning difficulties are not separately addressed. 'No extracardiac manifestations of Danon disease' and 'ICD had detected no untoward cardiac events' are general statements; the latter is recorded as written and does not exclude the ventricular tachycardia checklist item. Right ventricular 'size and function were within normal limits' does not address wall thickness, so right ventricular hypertrophy is left 'not reported'. Heart failure is not explicitly addressed (patient asymptomatic, preserved function) and is left 'not reported'. No contradictions requiring both-row treatment beyond the muscle findings above. JSON built with a short Python script from values read by hand; spans checked verbatim by script.
